register.labelZh: THINK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: think about 和 think of 能幫助你表達自己正在考慮甚麼、想起了甚麼,以及可能決定做甚麼。；think ahead 能幫助你預先考慮將來的需要;think twice 則表示在行動前停下來,再三考慮可能出現的問題。；think back 能用來談論回憶;think for yourself 則表示你會自己思考,而不是盲目跟隨別人。；think out、think over、think through 和 think up 能表達處理構思的不同階段,包括想出主意、仔細考慮及檢查每個細節。
register.summaryEn: Think about and think of help you explain what is on your mind, what you remember and what you may decide to do. Think ahead helps you prepare for future needs. Think twice helps you stop and consider possible problems before acting. Think back lets you describe memories. Think for yourself shows that you form your own opinion instead of simply following others. Think out, think over, think through and think up help you describe different stages of working with an idea—from inventing it to checking every detail.

questions.targetMeaningZh: 在決定前仔細考慮某事

questions.prompt: Readers should examine the facts and make their own judgement instead of simply accepting the article’s strong opinion.
